design_name: Wheel Drive Bench Demonstrator - Wheel Rim POC-03
assumptions: This is one simple wheel-rim placeholder for a bench-only proof of concept; it is not approved for manufacture, assembly, or powered testing.
The 80 mm outside diameter, 6 mm nominal bore, and 24 mm width are carried forward from the parent exploratory envelope and are not approved interface dimensions.
The 6 mm bore does not define a fit, tolerance, shaft engagement, or retention method.
The part is a plain annular cylinder with no tread, spokes, hub, fasteners, or other wheel features.
The part axis is global +Y in a right-handed Z-up coordinate system; the center of the base annular face is at the origin.
